(y) “Fully blocked” means stoppage of all types of commercial communication requiring explicit consent except commercial communication sent under inferred consent; (z) “Header” means alphanumeric string of maximum eleven characters or numbers assigned to an individual, business or legal entity under these regulations to send commercial communications; 6
